segments.text: OVt of the depe haue I called vnto thee, O Lorde: Lorde heare my voyce.
Oh let thine eares conſider well: the voyce of my complaynte.
If thou Lorde wilt be extreme to marke what is done amyſſe: Oh Lorde who may abyde it?
For there is mercy with thee: therfore ſhalt thou be feared.
I looke for the Lorde, my ſoule doeth wayte for hym: in his woorde is my truſt.
My ſoule flyeth vnto the Lorde, beefore the mornyng watche: I ſaye, before the morning watche.
O Iſrael truſt in the Lorde, for with the Lorde there is mercy: and with him is plenteous redempcion.
And he ſhall redeme Iſraell, from all his ſinnes.
As it was in the beginning. &c.
